name: open-bus-leaves-kerb-on-acute-turn
open: turnPath (world/turnPaths.ts chooseHandle) falls back to handle 0.65 when no handle keeps the largest body on the surface; where the exit lane starts outside the cone of the movement's headings (acute legs, wide roads) every smooth path must hook, and the body swings off the kerb. Needs lane-end placement at acute junctions and heavy-vehicle off-tracking (docs/completion-audit.md block 2).
